text:
Kara: Heads-up from Legal: inspector wants 24 months of auth/session logs "available for inspection". We keep 90d raw + 1y redacted. Need a short operational pattern: where to store 24m, KMS separation, JIT unwrap, RBAC, and playback throttles.

Vik: Suggestion: put 90-730d in cold 'inspection-bucket' encrypted by CMK 'inspection-cmk'. No day-to-day raw access. Two access modes: redacted search index for analysts; ticketed JIT raw playback for audits.

Omar: Ops notes: playback = risk to SIEM ingest. Default playback throttle 250 ev/s per tenant; require SRE coordination for >1M events. For >2M force manifest/batch export. Connector must honor 429 and backoff. Tag jobs with ticket id + cost-center.

Kara: Access control sketch: request flow -> security review -> if approved, mint ephemeral KMS unwrap token scoped to ticket and manifest (TTL=4h). Produce presigned download URLs (TTL=15m) or stream to SIEM with rate-limit hooks. All unwraps write immutable audit records to audit-bucket (retain 5y).

Vik: RBAC: roles 'inspection_requester' (open ticket), 'inspection_approver' (approve), 'inspection_unwrapper' (execute unwrap). Grants require ticket link, MFA, and approval audit. Only unwrap-service principal allowed in KMS key policy to call Decrypt with condition aws:RequestTag/ticket_id.

security-bot: TASK-3310 created: "Inspection archive playback controls" assigned to Vik. (automated)

oncall-sre: Add to runbook: default playback throttle 250 ev/s, off-peak scheduling for large jobs, auto-queue jobs exceeding throttle, auto-pause if connector 5xx/429 >5% for 5m. Require presigned URL usage over long-lived creds.

Omar: Example CLI:
```
/inspect-request --tenant=acme --start=2023-01-01 --end=2023-03-01 --purpose="external audit"
/inspect-approve REQ-3310 --approver=vik --mfa=true
```
On approval: mint token tied to REQ-3310, return presigned URLs or initiate controlled stream.

Kara: Audit schema minimal: requestor, ticket_id, approvers, unwrap_token_id, objects, bytes_delivered, start_ts, end_ts, job_id. Bundle uploaded to audit-bucket when job finishes.

Vik: Action items:
- Vik: draft KMS key policy + key rotation notes (due 2025-01-20)
- Omar: implement playback throttle + manifest gating in runbook & test harness (due 2025-01-15)
- Kara: update compliance response + evidence retention plan (due 2025-01-18)

Please ack.

Vik: ack :+1:

Omar: ack :thumbsup:
